hero_kpi_rationale: Ecolab generated $16.1 billion in annual sales in 2025, demonstrating strong market leadership as a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions across more than 170 countries and 40 industries

kpis.name: Annual Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue of the company for one year
kpis.description: Ecolab's annual revenue increased 2% to $16.1 billion in 2025 from $15.7 billion in 2024

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Ecolab's reported gross margin was 44.5% in 2025, compared to 43.5% in 2024, reflecting strong value pricing

kpis.name: Diluted Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Diluted earnings per share of the company
kpis.description: Ecolab's reported diluted EPS decreased 1% to $7.28 in 2025 from $7.37 in 2024, impacted by special gains and charges

kpis.name: Organic Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year organic revenue growth rate excluding acquisitions, divestitures and currency effects
kpis.description: Ecolab achieved 3% organic sales growth in 2025, driven by strong value pricing across segments

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has established a formal Information Systems Security Committee (ISSC) chaired by the CISO with representation from executive leadership across operations, finance and business divisions, indicating active governance of cybersecurity risks with significant resource allocation

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple jurisdictions and industries with evolving environmental and safety regulations that may require operational changes and capital investments

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: Ecolab operates in competitive global markets across water treatment, hygiene and infection prevention solutions, requiring ongoing innovation and market positioning

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on technology infrastructure and digital capabilities for operations and customer solutions, exposing it to technology obsolescence and cyber threats

risks.title: Talent Management
risks.score_rationale: With 48,000 associates globally, Ecolab faces risks in attracting and retaining skilled talent in competitive labor markets

risks.title: Environmental Risks
risks.score_rationale: As a company focused on water and sustainability solutions, Ecolab is exposed to environmental risks in its operations and products, with potential impact on reputation and operations

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Ecolab may face legal challenges related to its operations, products and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions
